parameters.content:
## Email Assistant — draft only
Default profileTestMode=true. This workflow has no SMTP node.

1. IMAP output is normalized by Core Mail Gateway.
2. Production message IDs are deduplicated in bounded static state.
3. LLM receives only delimited sanitized text through Core LLM Gateway.
4. Local validation removes unsupported contact fields.
5. Core Mail Gateway creates a draftOnly result. Owner review is exposed in n8n execution output.

Replace IMAP credential, model and opaque ownerRef before activation.
